entities.text: Munaga Siva, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
2019 
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.4968 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioner/accused seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Sessions Case No.108 of 2019 on the file of Additional Senior Civil Judge - cum - Additional Assistant Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Badvel, which was taken cognizance for the offences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and Sections 57, 58 r/w 26, 30 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act').
2.

entities.text: Additional Senior Civil Judge - cum - Additional Assistant Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court, Badvel
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that on 27.09.2018 at about 11.00 a.m., when the complainant along with his staff conducted raid in the petitioner's godown located at D.No.5/577,
Siva Nagar, Badvel Town, found the banned tobacco products and hence, seized the same and registered a case in Crime No.470 of 2018 of Badvel Urban Police Station, for the offences stated supra.

3. Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. So far as the offence under Section 188 of IPC is concerned, as per Section 195(1)(a)(i) of Cr.P.C,
no Court shall take cognizance of the said offence except on the complaint in writing of that Court or by such Officer of the Court as that Court may authorise in writing in this behalf, or of some other Court to which that Court is subordinate.
However, in the instant case, the F.I.R is registered suo moto basing on the report of the Sub-Inspector of Police of Badvel Urban Police Station.

entities.text: Police of Badvel Urban Police Station
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Therefore,
it is the violation of Section 195 of Cr.P.C so far as the Section 188 of IPC is concerned and therefore,
the said offence is also liable to be quashed.

5. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners/accused under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and Sections 57, 58 r/w 26, 30 of FSS Act are hereby quashed.
